scope: No new inference, GPU, server, artificial memory allocation, threshold change, or product integration.

findings.astra_default_1m: Q118 replayed 707 real AMD05 samples: RSS max 51.305591583 GiB; MemAvailable min 58.697692871 GiB; host PSI max 53.61%; no guard stop, OOM, or worker swap.
findings.sol: Q34 TP=2 dual RTX 3090 completed without OOM; continuous PSI was not recorded, so it cannot calibrate a temporal threshold.
findings.rss: The AMD05 guard does not stop solely on RSS. It has immediate MemAvailable <32 GiB and OOM stops; its candidate severe-pressure stop requires global severe PSI plus MemAvailable <48 GiB for 15 consecutive samples. Worker cgroup PSI is diagnostic.
findings.integration: AMD05 is candidate-only and not integrated into Q97/Q100 or production; Q97/Q100 are harness-level guards that use host MemAvailable/PSI/OOM, not RSS alone.
findings.known_gap: Q116 found that the active Q97/Q100 helper keeps independent streak counters for severe PSI full and some. If full>=60% and some>=80% alternate while the OR condition is true on every sample, the 15-sample stop does not fire. Q116-A2 composite-streak helper passed 5/5 but is candidate-only, not integrated.
findings.limits: The successful ASTRA trace did not exercise the severe-PSI-plus-low-headroom stop. SOL has no continuous PSI trace. This review does not explain Codex/GUI crashes and does not prove behavior under every low-headroom/severe-pressure profile.

existing_tests.rerun: not repeated; exact receipt/hash replay already exists
